R. Q. 2 تَنَجْنَجَ He was in a state of commotion, or agitated, and confounded, perplexed, or amazed. (K.) ―
-b2- تنجنج فِى رَأْيِهِ, and ↓ نَجْنَجَ فِيهِ , He was confounded, or perplexed, and agitated, in his judgment, or opinion. (TA.) ―
-b3- تَنَجْنَجَ لَحْمُهُ His flesh became much and flabby. (S.) Accord. to F, this is a mistake for تَبَجْبَجَ; but Hr agrees herein with J. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
